title: Typing 3. starts a numbered list that continues itself
steps: Launch Mail with -UseFakeGmail and open a new message
In the body type 3. and a space, then Plan, Return, Book
Send it to a synthetic recipient and open it from Sent
expected: The line becomes a numbered list at 3 and Return adds 4. The sent message shows 3. Plan and 4. Book in both the formatted and the plain-text part.
